title: Design
description: ALWAYS use for logos, Instagram/LinkedIn/Facebook posts and stories, posters, flyers, banners, thumbnails, cover images, graphic design, and creatives. Single-canvas graphics with size presets (logo, IG post, story, poster) and PNG export. NEVER use Slides or HTML mocks for these — instantiate format.design. After createGadget, call setPreset and edit layers via RPC.
